description: The API behind Easmark: accounts, marking for theses and code, credits and payments, coupons and analytics, documented in Swagger.
contributions: Accounts: sign-up with email verification, login, logout, token refresh and password reset
Marking: marking types with their prices, performing a marking, and saving and archiving results
Credits: balance, usage, payments through Stripe, pricing tiers and transaction history
Coupons: create, assign to users or user types, revoke, and list assignments
Analytics for each user and for the platform
results: One documented API behind the Easmark app

body.heading: What it does
paragraphs: Easmark API is everything behind the Easmark app. It holds accounts, runs marking for theses and code, keeps each user's credits, takes payments and applies coupons, and reports usage. The Easmark page explains the product; this one is the service.

body.heading: Built with
paragraphs: Django and Django REST Framework with PostgreSQL, JSON Web Tokens for sign-in, Stripe for payments, and Swagger for the documentation.
